name: Kelvin McQueen
abstract_title: Consciousness cannot be a purely quantum phenomenon
abstract: What are the physical requirements for consciousness? Building on our earlier work on the physical requirements for agency (arxiv.org/abs/2510.13247), we argue that a purely quantum system (one evolving unitarily in a coherent regime without decoherence or collapse) fails to satisfy two plausible requirements for consciousness.
